avis.texte: Nothing comes close to what this does for my skin. My skin feels physically smooth after each use. It exfoliates and brightens any scarring that i have. It doesnt feel drying at all. I would highly recommend.

It really works great. Just use as directed. Even when I take breaks and come back the the even tone cleansing bar, I noticed it working in days. It fades/clears up my acne marks very quickly. It suds up easily, and the sponge really cleans your face well.

It had done wonders to my skin in such a short period of time. My pores have minimized and feels tighter. I also have developed some skin tags on my neck and I swear it is literally making them smaller and they are disappearing.
Please do better about telling consumers the product is not available instead of taking out money and taking weeks to return it.

This cleasing bar is so good. I really leaves my face feeling squeaky clean, and I love the little sponge it comes with, because it exfoliates too. This is definitely a strong cleanse, so maybe once a week I use something gentler, but if I go a few days without using this, I notice immediately that my face feels greasier and sometimes I break out around my chin. I often let the foam generated by scrubbing with the sponge sit on my face for a moment, especially if I have a spot on my chin. As for evening tone, I honestly haven't noticed a change in this, but I have really fair skin that is always showing redness, and I don't think a simple bar of soap can ultimately affect that. I tried this cleansing bar a few years ago in an Ulta sale, and I've been using it religiously ever since; it is one of the few products I never switch out, always use to the end, and make sure to always have on hand.

..but the girl recommended this. I have used it for a couple of months and it last a long time. I don't keep it in the shower and I never rave the sponge in the jar. Then I started to see something g black creep up, when I dug into it, I found a layer of black mold. I thinks that's a bit dangerous and not worth the trouble.

As someone that has dry and sensitive skin, you have to work your way up with this product. Start off by using 3 times a week and if your skin can tolerate it, up the days. This product is not going to work over night and you have to be consistent. I only wash my face at night. The retinol, the serum and the orange bottle serum are also staples in my skin care routine. avis.titre: Wouldn't recommend for People with Rosacea
avis.texte: Let me start by saying that my skin is very sensitive, 48 years old, impacted with rosacea and additional intermittent eczema. That being said this product line is purported to be safe for sensitive reactive aged skin. Also let me say that the reaction I experienced with this product line was not retinol purging. I had been using IS Clinical Products for several years including their anti-aging retinol products. Unfortunately I used these products only twice and I dealt with a severe flare up of rosacea & eczema. So now this cream sits in my plastic tub that collects products I have purchased yet can't use. I can't comment on long-term effectiveness or if the products work as claimed by marketing jargon. One other thing. WHAT is with the horrible scent of this product line? If I hadn't had a hypersensitivity reaction to these products and even if they worked as marketed I wouldn't have repurchased any of these products because they smell horrible.

This has become my daily cleanser. I'm buying my third jar, and i love it. A little goes a long way and it travels super well too. My skin tone has absolutely improved and it helps to clear my skin. It is a bit harsh if you overdo it, but ive found you just have to be careful and not scrub too hard. I do use it as a mask a few times a week, but you dont want to leave it on too long. Ive had no problems putting my retinol on over it too!

Leaves my skin feeling clean. BUT It burns while I am rubbing with the sponge pad, + after when applying my toner, serum, moisturizer (different brands). It inflames my breakouts--I think they started to pop up after I used it :( and looks like it's a rash. Is it purging or just irritating on my skin ??? :(((

I got a .5 oz free sample of this cleanser and am about to purchase the full size because I like it so much. I've used it every night and noticed my face looks glowy and the brown sun spot in the middle of my forehead that I've been fighting for a few years is much, much less noticeable, almost gone. I have very sensitive skin so I use a very gentle CeraVe wash in the morning, but this has been my night time go-to. This hasn't irritated my eczema or rosacea at all. Also, the .5 oz lasted so long.

I love this cleanser. I noticed after one use my skin looked brighter, less red, and less dull. Ive been using it for about a month now and it has worked really well for me! It lathers very well and removes all my makeup. The only downside i have noticed is that it might be drying for some - my skin has that squeaky clean/ semi-dry feeling after using it so i do not use this cleanser everyday. I use it about 3-4 times a week in place of my regular cleanser, but thats the only negative thing i can say about this cleanser. Still giving 5 stars because this could be a perfect product for someone with a combination or oily skin type.
This product helps clear my skin every time! It lightens my dark spots and makes my face glow! This plus sunscreen is a great combo for clear skin!

Im only giving it 4 stars as of right now because its only the first day but I bet it will be 5 stars by the end of next week. Coming from an ulta employee who doesnt write reviews, buy it!

I've always had acne-prone skin and even though as I've gotten older it's gotten better, I do still break out- especially during my monthly cycle. I was extremely excited to try the Even Tone Cleansing Bar complimentary from Urban Skin Rx in exchange for my honest review. This revolutionary skincare product has gone viral on social media and I can definitely see why. It was developed by an aesthetician, so right off the bat I was confident that it was going to be a winner. It is formulated with what they call "ClearTone Advanced Technology®" which has ingredients like Kojic Acid, Azelaic Acid and Niacinamide- all are known to be beneficial to skin, especially when it comes to brightening and evening the skin tone. I loved that it is technically a soap but it comes with two circular sponges so there's no putting the soap on your hands and then your face. I used it the day I received it and have been using it daily and my skin is bright, more even and clear!!! Also, it can be used as a mask- just leave it on for a bit longer and then wash off. Who doesn't love a multitasker?!? I know I do and I'll be keeping this in my daily routine!!

It's also very gentle due to the ingredients it has. It doesn't leave any redness. I'm amazed by its effectiveness.
I have tried different cleaners but this one is very compatible with my skin. I use this cleaner and the Retinol Rapid Repair & Dark Spot Treatment and both have given me the results I need.

I received this product complimentary from Urban Skin rx for my honest review. This cleanser comes with two sponges which I thought is nice. I was expecting the sponge to be hard and rough on my skin but once you add water to it, it puffs up a little and felt nice against your skin. When I was rubbing the sponge against the bar, I wasn't sure if anything was happening since you couldn't see anything on the sponge. However, when I rubbed the sponge against my face, I could feel that it did do something because I can feel the cleanser in the sponge. It was lathering up nicely and did a good job to exfoliate my face. I felt like it did a really good job of getting my face clean. I really like that you didn't need very much cleanser to get a good lather. Overall, I like this even tone cleansing bar.

I was gifted by urbanskinrx Even Tone Cleansing Bar in exchange for a review. I was impressed with the packaging design, it's a shallow jar that contains the soap and two sponges. I liked the scent of soft tea tree and licorice, The sponge helps lather the soap and is used to spread the soap evenly in a controlled manner over the face. The soap is gentle on the skin. I was hesitant about the maintaining the cleanliness of the sponge. The kit comes with two sponges and it's suggested to air dry the sponge between uses. After a while, bacteria and buildup could occur, but with some research on the RX website, they suggested that you could clean the sponge by tossing it in with your laundry. This eases some of my concern.

(Gifted by Urban Skin Rx) This gives me such a good cleanse. I have acne prone skin, large pores, acne marks and combination skin. This cleanser feels great and leaves my skin super clean. The sponge is very nice and provides some gentle exfoliation. I tried using the cleanser as a mask too and I think my face looks a bit brighter and more clear since I've started using it. Definitely recommend for people with similar concerns as me!

I love that it's a three in one product it cleanses, exfoliates, and you can also mask with it and super gentle on the skin and not to abrasive. It smells amazing and helps with my skin texture and brighten it as well. Gifted by Urban Skin Rx.
